items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: We talk about Asano. She was married to Asano and then she married Emil Laud.

ctx.x: With Laud. That's right. That's his mother's place. We talk about Asano. She was married to Asano and then she married Emil Laud. And now she's married to George Lopez. The first two months was the past.
Well, anyway, what was back there where the mortuary is?
